name: Product Detailing
description: Introduction to Injection Moulding. Semantic Priming – understanding and developing a formal framework using a semantic route, utilising antonyms to develop a range of forms. Introduction to modelling and surfacing, details and assembly techniques in moulded components. Converting forms to shells and assemblies and printing them. Understanding compliant mechanisms and creating a single piece, one shot product which incorporates one. Measuring a set of given components, understanding adjacencies and connections, developing a design brief, form and feature ideation, modelling, printing / fabricating, testing and creating a functional prototype.
